Practice areas

What Will Fraley handles

His practice covers criminal defense, family law and personal injury.

  • 01

    Criminal defense

    Charged with DUI, a drug offense, theft, fraud, domestic assault, a violent or sex offense, or a probation violation? Will Fraley and his team personally handle criminal cases, big or small.

    Criminal defense

  • 02

    Family law

    Divorce, child custody, visitation, parenting plan changes, paternity, adoption and DCS cases. Your children come first, and so does a plan that works.

    Family law

  • 03

    Personal injury

    Will Fraley also handles personal injury cases, such as vehicle accidents, slip-and-fall injuries and dog bites.

    Personal injury

All practice areas

About Will Fraley

Why people call Will Fraley

  • Criminal court and family court are his focus. Will dedicates his practice to defending clients in criminal court and advocating for parents and spouses in family court. If a charge and a family case land at the same time, you can talk to one lawyer about both.
  • Your case gets personal attention. Will Fraley and his team personally handle each case, no matter how big or small.
  • He is from here. Will is a Tennessee native who moved to Murfreesboro in 1992 to attend Middle Tennessee State University. He made the city his home and built his private practice here.
  • He keeps training. Will has completed advanced cross-examination training with the Tennessee Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers.
  • He is part of the local bar. Will is a member of the Tennessee Bar Association, the Rutherford and Cannon County Bar Association and the Tennessee Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers.
  • He serves the whole area. Will represents clients in Murfreesboro and the surrounding counties of Rutherford, Coffee and Wilson.

Common questions

Questions people ask first

Is the first consultation free?

Yes. Call (615) 410-7290 for a free consultation.

What kinds of cases does Will Fraley handle?

Criminal defense, family law and personal injury. On the criminal side, that ranges from DUI charges to domestic assault accusations. On the family side, it includes divorce, child custody and parenting plan modifications.

Can I get help in Spanish?

Yes. Se habla español, and Spanish-speaking services are available.

Where is the office, and when is it open?

The office is at 509 W College St, Murfreesboro, TN 37130. Hours are Monday through Thursday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., and Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
